preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and n*(n-1)/2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u_i, v_i) must connect distinct vertices numbered between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of edge pairs provided must match the given number of edges m.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'Yes' and len(stdout.splitlines()[1]) == n and all(c in 'abc' for c in stdout.splitlines()[1])
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'Yes', the second line must be a string of length n consisting only of the letters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'No' or all((u_i, v_i) in edges or (v_i, u_i) in edges if abs(ord(stdout.splitlines()[1][u_i - 1]) - ord(stdout.splitlines()[1][v_i - 1])) in [0, 1] else True for u_i, v_i in edges)
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'Yes', the string must produce the given graph G where each edge (u_i, v_i) connects vertices with either the same or adjacent letters.
